title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the specific study zones, specialized labs, and quiet corners that Bentley students use to navigate their rigorous business curriculum and collaborative projects.

cards.title: The Back Reading Rooms
cards.subtitle: Bentley Library Upper and Main Levels
cards.notes: Head to the back reading rooms on the main and upper floors for near-total silence. These designated Red Zones are strictly for focused, individual work without distraction.
cards.short_summary: Strictly silent study areas located in the rear of the library's main and upper floors.
cards.evidence_claim: The library designates the back reading rooms on the main and upper levels as Silent Study Zones (Red Zones) for students who prefer an almost silent environment.
cards.access_notes: Open during library operating hours; accessible to all students with a valid ID.

cards.title: Collaborative Work at The Bubble
cards.subtitle: Student Center Third Floor
cards.notes: Utilize the long tables and high-top seating for group projects. It offers a lively atmosphere where you can stay productive while remaining connected to the campus hub.
cards.short_summary: A popular collaborative study area on the top floor of the Student Center with ample outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bubble is a well-known study spot on the top floor of the Student Center featuring long tables, high-top seating, and charging stations.
cards.access_notes: Located on the 3rd floor; open during Student Center hours.

cards.title: The Trading Room
cards.subtitle: Smith Academic Technology Center 226
cards.notes: Access 24 Bloomberg terminals and real-time financial data. This high-tech lab is the go-to spot for finance majors to practice market analysis and portfolio management.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art investment research center with 60 workstations and Bloomberg terminals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Trading Room features 60 workstations and 24 Bloomberg terminals for investment research and financial technology training.
cards.source_title: Trading Room (Hughey Center for Financial Services) | Bentley University
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of Smith; check lab hours for open access.

cards.title: Quiet Reading in the Bowles Room
cards.subtitle: Bentley Library Lower Level
cards.notes: Find a quiet nook among the 2,600-volume personal library of Edward Bowles. It is an ideal spot for hushed reading or using the dedicated video viewing stations.
cards.short_summary: A quiet lower-level room housing a donated book collection and video viewing equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bowles Room on the lower level contains a 2,600-volume collection and 8 stations for viewing VHS or DVD content.
cards.access_notes: Designated as a Quiet Study Zone (Orange Zone) where hushed conversation is permitted.

cards.title: The Orange Chair Nooks
cards.subtitle: Morison Hall End Corridors
cards.notes: Seek out the quiet hallways at the end of Morison Hall. These nooks with orange chairs offer a secluded alternative to the library during busy finals weeks.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, lesser-known study spaces with orange chairs located at the ends of Morison Hall corridors.
cards.evidence_claim: Morison Hall contains study spaces with orange chairs and glass-encased study rooms that are known by students as quiet spots for finals.
cards.source_title: Best Hidden Places to Study Around Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; limited seating available.

cards.title: The CIS Sandbox
cards.subtitle: Smith Academic Technology Center 234
cards.notes: Collaborate on tech projects in this social learning space. It is staffed by peer tutors who can help with IT and computer information systems coursework.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative technology learning lab and social space for CIS students.
cards.evidence_claim: The CIS Sandbox is a learning lab where students work on technology projects and receive peer support.
cards.access_notes: Located in Smith 234; open to all students during lab hours.

cards.title: Jennison Hall Collaboratories
cards.subtitle: Jennison Hall Floors 2-4
cards.notes: Use the movable tablet desks and integrated technology for group brainstorming. These modern rooms are designed for flexible, interactive team sessions.
cards.short_summary: Modernized classrooms in Jennison Hall equipped with mobile furniture and collaborative tech.
cards.evidence_claim: Jennison Hall features active learning classrooms with tablet desks on casters and collaboratory rooms with shared displays.
cards.access_notes: Available for student use when classes are not in session.

cards.title: The MCC Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Center Level 2
cards.notes: Recharge in this student-designed space. It serves as a comfortable community hub for connection and quiet study between classes.
cards.short_summary: A recently renovated lounge in the Student Center providing a space for community and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claudette Blot Multicultural Center Lounge was redesigned by students to create a space for community members to recharge and connect.
cards.source_title: Bentley Unveils Newly Renovated Multicultural Center Lounge
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of the Student Center.

cards.title: Adamian Corner Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Adamian Academic Center Third Floor
cards.notes: Find the large study room on the third floor for ample table space and natural light. It is often quieter than central campus spots due to its peripheral location.
cards.short_summary: Spacious study rooms in the Adamian Academic Center known for natural light and quiet.
cards.evidence_claim: The Adamian Academic Center contains a large study room on the third floor and smaller rooms near the parking lot side that offer natural light and quiet.
cards.source_title: Best Hidden Places to Study Around Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; check for room availability on the third floor.

cards.title: The HUSH Pod
cards.subtitle: Bentley Library
cards.notes: Book this single-occupancy soundproof pod for Zoom interviews or hybrid classes. It provides a private, quiet environment within the library's open floors.
cards.short_summary: A single-occupancy soundproof acoustic room for private calls and focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library features a HUSH Pod, which is a single-occupancy soundproof space for hybrid classes or interviews.
cards.source_title: Hush Pod Acoustic Room | Bentley University Library
cards.access_notes: Available for student and staff use; check library for reservation details.
